description: This Java interface defines connectivity-related events within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including constants, method signatures, and JSON field definitions for connection events.

classes.name: ConnectivityEvent
classes.description: Interface for all connection-related events, providing methods for accessing connection identifiers, resource type, and headers, along with JSON field definitions.

classes.name: ConnectivityEvent.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for connection event payloads, including connection ID and connection object.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the connection identifier as a String; deprecated in favor of getConnectionEntityId.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId object representing the connection.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID, defaulting to getConnectionEntityId.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer representing the resource path.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; connectivity events do not have revisions.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; connectivity events do not support revision setting.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the event.
